state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors argue AI supervision may be more efficient than human feedback and that humans and AI may collaborate to supervise better than either alone, and say scaling supervision may be one way to oversee AI systems at or beyond human level if the supervisor's capability can scale proportionally with the actor's capabilities and the supervisor remains aligned with intended goals and constraints.
title: Scaling supervision needs supervisor capability to scale with the actor and stay aligned
